structure.unit: Other Sources of Energy; Energy Policy

law.text: As used in this article, unless the context requires a different meaning: "Board" means the Clean Energy Advisory Board created pursuant to § 45.2-1913. "Fund" means the Low-to-Moderate Income Solar Loan and Rebate Fund created pursuant to § 45.2-1916. "Program" means the Low-to-Moderate Income Solar Loan and Rebate Pilot Program created pursuant to § 45.2-1917.
